title: West End/Sylvan park Studio Near Vandy
description:
Stay in a quiet, safe neighborhood just minutes from downtown Nashville! This charming main level studio apartment is across from the Richland Greenway, leading to Centennial Park. Walk to Sylvan Park’s shops, restaurants, and public transit. Vanderbilt and West End are close by, with downtown just a 5-minute drive. Enjoy a full kitchen, WiFi, and easy access to the airport (20 min). Perfect for a relaxing stay in Music City!

The space
This cozy studio offers a comfortable and inviting space with beautiful hardwood floors throughout. The room features a **queen bed** for a restful night’s sleep, along with a **futon sofa** for extra seating or a lounging space. The **full kitchen** is equipped with all the essentials for cooking, making it easy to enjoy a homemade meal. Whether you're staying for business or leisure, this studio provides the perfect blend of comfort and convenience for your stay.

Guest access
Guests have use to entire apartment.
